title: Public dice rolls
description: Every die the engine rolls that the table would see (gravity rifts, combat, abilities) is a public event with who rolled, what for, the faces, the outcome and the system. The web shows it as a corner toast and as a line in the event log. All shots are the real app against a mocked game; the server side is covered by engine, server and replay tests.

shots.heading: Gravity rift roll toast
shots.caption: Another player's ship leaves a gravity rift: the toast names who rolled, the rift system, the die and what it did (ship destroyed). This is the case from alpha feedback fb_1791904377.

shots.heading: Your own roll
shots.caption: The roller is told too; the toast carries the Dice tag.

shots.heading: A combat round is one toast
shots.caption: Two dice rolls of one combat round for one player merge into a single toast with the hits totalled, not one toast per die.

shots.heading: Event log
shots.caption: Rolls are lines of their own between the decisions they happened between: faces as chips (hits filled, misses dimmed, rerolled dice dashed), the reason, the system and the outcome. They have no Undo button; the decisions around them keep theirs.

notes.title: Not shown
notes.text: Spy's die is not public (it would reveal which card was taken from a hand). Rolls appear in the log after the engine step that made them returns, so a roll inside a long combat window appears once the window moves on.
